_comment: ADR-0109 lifecycle-status gate policy. ONE required lane over EVERY config in configs_dir, replacing the nine tools/oya-governance-*-lifecycle-app dev-CLI crates that were never referenced by .github/workflows/** and therefore enforced nothing for their entire lifetime. Adding a lifecycle is a CONFIG file here, never a new crate; the completeness dimension makes an unevaluated config fail closed, so a lane cannot be born dark the way the nine dev-CLIs were. MEASURED on the live corpus at first wiring: only 2 of the 9 declared lifecycles observe anything at all.
purpose: ADR-0109 lifecycle state-machine ratchet: every declared lifecycle config is evaluated against the live corpus, per (lane, violation_kind) counts are frozen shrink-only, and a lane that cannot see its corpus is blocking rather than vacuously green.

frozen_violation_baseline._comment: FROZEN shrink-only per (lane, violation_kind) counts, MEASURED against the live corpus. An absent pair is born-blocking; growth is a regression; a count that FALLS makes this baseline stale and must shrink in the same reviewed PR, so a fixed violation cannot leave headroom for the next one. Only the two lanes that actually observe a corpus appear here — the other seven are in known_broken_lanes and are deliberately unbaselined, because a baseline over an unobservable corpus certifies nothing.

adr-status-lifecycle._comment: 440 ADRs observed. stage_not_declared = the ADR carries no frontmatter `status:` scalar the kernel can read; unknown_stage = a `status:` value outside the config's proposed/accepted/superseded/archived enum (e.g. Rejected, which ADR-0382 legitimately uses and the config does not yet model).

doc-status-lifecycle._comment: 2666 docs observed. This is the repo's largest single ungoverned-status corpus and the reason this lane must be a ratchet rather than a flag day: 72% of tracked docs declare no lifecycle stage at all.

known_broken_lanes._comment: Lanes that CANNOT observe a live corpus today. Every one was measured, not assumed. A listed lane may fail discovery or observe zero artifacts without reddening the required context; an UNLISTED lane doing either is born-blocking. Shrink-only in both directions: a listed lane that starts observing artifacts fails with known_broken_lane_now_live and must lose its entry in the same PR, and an entry naming a deleted config also fails. Every entry states a resolution — a defect with no resolution is a permanent excuse, and the parser rejects it. These seven are the disposition question this gate makes VISIBLE rather than answers: each needs a re-root-or-delete ruling, and until one lands the lane is honestly recorded as enforcing nothing instead of reporting a clean green.

api-stability-tier-lifecycle.defect: source root docs/api-stability does not exist; the lane has never observed an artifact
api-stability-tier-lifecycle.resolution: re-root onto the live API-stability surface (registry/catalog *.yaml api_stability fields) or delete the config, and delete this entry in the same PR

capability-status-lifecycle.defect: source root resolves but the glob matches ZERO artifacts, so the lane evaluates perfectly clean while observing nothing — a vacuous green the kernel cannot detect because its glob only errors on a missing directory
capability-status-lifecycle.resolution: re-root onto the live capability surface (specs/capability-registry.json / <cap>/catalog) or delete the config, and delete this entry in the same PR

crate-status-lifecycle.defect: source root crates/*-domain does not exist — the capability-first reorg (ADR-0562) moved every crate out of crates/ and the config was never re-rooted; this is the reorg-move scan-root blindness class
crate-status-lifecycle.resolution: re-root onto the live crate surface (registry/catalog/*.yaml) or delete the config, and delete this entry in the same PR

dependency-status-lifecycle.defect: source root docs/dependencies does not exist; the lane has never observed an artifact
dependency-status-lifecycle.resolution: re-root onto registry/dependency-rationales.json / oya-deps.toml or delete the config, and delete this entry in the same PR

feature-flag-status-lifecycle.defect: source root docs/feature-flags does not exist; the lane has never observed an artifact
feature-flag-status-lifecycle.resolution: re-root onto the live feature-flag surface or delete the config, and delete this entry in the same PR

migration-status-lifecycle.defect: source root .omc/plans/milestones is GITIGNORED agent operational state, absent from every CI checkout by construction — this lane could never have run in required CI even if it had been wired
migration-status-lifecycle.resolution: re-root onto a tracked migration surface (docs/migration-playbooks, specs/reorg/*.json) or delete the config, and delete this entry in the same PR

plan-status-lifecycle.defect: source root .omc/plans/milestones is GITIGNORED agent operational state, absent from every CI checkout by construction — same structural defect as migration-status-lifecycle
plan-status-lifecycle.resolution: re-root onto the tracked masterplan surface (specs/masterplan.json) or delete the config, and delete this entry in the same PR
